1. (Currently amended) A system for providing security in a computer system, the system comprising:
a hardware entropy source configured to generate a plurality of independent first entropy values;
one or more logic circuits physically coupled to the hardware entropy source and configured to:
receive the plurality of independent first entropy values from the hardware entropy source;
apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to a function to generate a second entropy value;
seed a pseudorandom number generator with the second entropy value;
generate a random number using the pseudorandom number generator seeded with the second entropy value; and
produce a block of ciphertext or message authentication code using the random number;
wherein the one or more logic circuits are further configured to implement __countermeasures against phase tracking attacks on the hardware entropy source__.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the one or more logic circuits being configured to produce the block of ciphertext or message authentication code includes being configured to produce the block of ciphertext or message authentication code with a key composed of or derived from the random number, __and wherein the countermeasures include at least one of: varying a sampling phase of the hardware entropy source, introducing phase jitter, or applying phase-dependent filtering__.

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the one or more logic circuits being configured to produce the block of ciphertext or message authentication code includes being configured to at least:
implement a key-agreement protocol using the random number and in which a key is produced; and
produce the block of ciphertext or message authentication code using the key.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the hardware entropy source is a ring oscillator, and the one or more logic circuits being configured to receive the plurality of independent first entropy values includes being configured to receive the plurality of independent first entropy values from the ring oscillator, __and wherein the countermeasures include at least one of: dynamically adjusting ring oscillator frequency, introducing frequency modulation, or applying frequency-dependent entropy filtering__.

5. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the hardware entropy source is a single hardware source, and the one or more logic circuits being configured to receive the plurality of independent first entropy values includes being configured to receive the plurality of independent first entropy values from the single hardware source.

6. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the one or more logic circuits being configured to receive the plurality of independent first entropy values includes being configured to receive the plurality of independent first entropy values from __a plurality of independent hardware entropy sources__.

7. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the function is a permutation function, and the one or more logic circuits being configured to apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the function includes being configured to apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the permutation function.

8. (Currently amended) The system of claim 7, wherein the one or more logic circuits being configured to apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the function includes being configured to:
divide the plurality of independent first entropy values into multiple groups of independent first entropy values;
apply the multiple groups of independent first entropy values to the permutation function to generate permuted groups of entropy values; and
concatenate the permuted groups of entropy values to generate the second entropy value.

9. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the function is a hash function, and the one or more logic circuits being configured to apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the function includes being configured to apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the hash function, __and wherein the countermeasures include applying the hash function with variable input ordering or variable hash parameters__.

10. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the function is a bit-mixer, and the one or more logic circuits being configured to apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the function includes being configured to apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the bit-mixer, __and wherein the countermeasures include applying the bit-mixer with variable mixing patterns or variable bit rotation parameters__.

11. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the one or more logic circuits being configured to apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the function includes being configured to selectively apply multiple entropy values of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the function to generate the second entropy value, __and wherein the selective application includes phase-dependent or frequency-dependent selection logic__.
